mapper.select: SELECT taer.`tech_ach_evaluation_report_id`, taer.`publish_time`, taer.`application_status`, taer.`evaluation_status`, ta.`technology_achievement_id` AS tech_ach_id, ta.`title`, ta.`category` FROM tech_ach_evaluation_report AS taer INNER JOIN technology_achievement AS ta ON taer.`technology_achievement_id` = ta.`technology_achievement_id` WHERE taer.`user_id` = #{userId} ORDER BY taer.`publish_time` DESC
